bullets: • Only write AC verifiable by reading HTML, CSS, or JS files directly; no external tools.
• Name the exact selector and file (e.g. 'h1 in index.html') rather than describing visual output.
• Specify exact hex color values; never describe colors by name or appearance.
• When changing a CSS property, include an AC that confirms no duplicate rules for that property exist.
• When changing a color, include an AC that -webkit-text-fill-color and background-clip:text are absent or overridden.
• Keep AC to 3-4 items; each must be a single testable fact about the file contents.
